observations: In this pass I re-opened assets/panels/03-2.png and the re-rendered workflow/review/page-03.png with Read. The panel hash in this request (f1388d13...) matches the earlier request.

Priya matches checkin-patients.png: a high ponytail with a blue scrunchie, hoop earrings, almond eyes with winged lashes, short brows, a small mark near her lips, a coral-pink kurti and the dark crossbody bag. She walks toward the clinic's teal awning, smiling.
Her hands match production. Her far (left) hand holds the phone, and her near (right) index finger taps the check-mark card.
The phone shows only a calendar icon and a teal check-mark card. Through the glass, the TV strip is empty and the desk monitor is blank. There is no readable text or signage.

Page-03.png: the caption is now a four-line box at the top right, over the upper awning and the top of the glass door. The ponytail tuft and the top of her head are now entirely outside the box, with open sky between them and the box. The earlier coverage of her ponytail is resolved.

Her contact with the new box: its left edge runs right beside the outer contour of the loose strands to the right of her face, about at eye level down to the box's bottom edge. At the size I can view, the box border and the hair outline touch or nearly touch, but no hair mass, strand interior or face area is hidden inside the box. I cannot rule out an overlap of a pixel or two along the outer contour line, because I could not view it at higher magnification.
I judge that the box covers no meaningful hair and no face. Her eyes, earring, mouth, the phone (protected area) and both hands are fully clear.

Optional for the lettering stage: the tangent edge reads a little cramped. Moving the box a few pixels right, or making it slightly shorter, would give a visible gap. This is not an artwork defect and does not block this pass.
